entries.title: Psalms 18:1
segments: This psalm is nearly the same as

entries.title: Psalms 18:2
segments:
My rock, and my fortress; source of support and security. 
 
The Lord is the safeguard and protector of his people, and supplication to him in all times of trouble is the grand means of deliverance.

entries.title: Psalms 18:4
segments:
vv 4-5. 
 
  Sorrows of death-- sorrows of hell; or, Cords of death, cords of hell; that is, snares set to take away his life and bring him down to hell, the word hell being here used, as in

, for the place of the dead. 
 
  Prevented me; met me and stopped my way, wherever I turned.

entries.title: Psalms 18:9
segments:
Bowed the heavens; bent them aside as a curtain. 
 
At the appearance of God all the elements do him homage, and as his servants are entirely under his control.  He uses them and disposes of them as seemeth good in his sight.

entries.title: Psalms 18:10
segments: Cherub; the cherubim are represented as the bearers of God's throne,

entries.title: Psalms 18:12
segments: At the brightness that was before him; literally, From the brightness before him.  Jehovah is represented as dwelling in light unapproachable, whence proceed thick clouds with tempests of hail and lightning.

entries.title: Psalms 18:14
segments: Scattered them; my enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 18:15
segments: Channels of waters--foundations of the world; the deep abysses of the sea.  These are made bare by the convulsions of nature.

entries.title: Psalms 18:16
segments: Many waters; numerous and great troubles.

entries.title: Psalms 18:18
segments:
Prevented me; thrust themselves before me and intercepted my escape. 
 
In times of calamity the Lord is the support of his people, and he will deliver and save all who put their trust in him.

entries.title: Psalms 18:25
segments: The Lord will treat men, in many respects, as the treat their fellow men.

entries.title: Psalms 18:26
segments: Show thyself froward; be opposed to those who oppose thee.

entries.title: Psalms 18:28
segments: Light my candle; grant him light in darkness.

entries.title: Psalms 18:29
segments:
By my God; by his help. 
 
  Leaped over a wall; surmounted the wall of the enemy's fortress, and thus taken it by storm.

entries.title: Psalms 18:30
segments: Buckler; shield, protection.

entries.title: Psalms 18:32
segments: For all their successes the people of God are indebted to him, and to him they give up the glory.

entries.title: Psalms 18:33
segments:
Like hinds' feet; the hind is celebrated for its fleetness. 
 
  Upon my high places; where I am safe from my enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 18:34
segments: Is broken; or, is bent.  The bending of a bow of steel represents the strength he has received from Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 18:40
segments: The necks of mine enemies; caused my enemies to turn their backs before me.

entries.title: Psalms 18:41
segments: The wicked may call upon God when he will not answer; they may seek him early and not find him.  If they hate knowledge, and do not choose the fear of the Lord, they must eat the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.

entries.title: Psalms 18:42
segments: Beat them small; utterly destroy them.

entries.title: Psalms 18:45
segments: Their close places; their fortresses.

entries.title: Psalms 18:50
segments: To his seed; to whom God had confirmed the kingdom for ever.
The seed of David is, in a special sense, Christ; and, in Christ, all who have like precious faith with David.
